answer.justification: The gastrohepatic ligament (part of the lesser omentum) separates the greater sac from the lesser sac. Dividing it opens the lesser sac, providing access to the space posterior to the stomach and the anterior pancreas. The other ligaments listed do not provide entry to this space.

decision.reason: Standard surgical anatomy: cutting the gastrohepatic ligament opens the lesser sac, allowing posterior gastric access to the pancreas.
